domain:
Business domain: real estate claims processing
Region: Australia and New Zealand
prompt:
Write complete CTL2 for this Normalizer.

An Australia and New Zealand real estate claims processor exports temporary-accommodation coverage allocations for uninhabitable residential properties. Apply the following priority schedule: use only the first matching rule and emit its allocations in left-to-right order.

1 | accommodation_end equals null | UNRESOLVED {allocated_nights=0, allocation_start=accommodation_start plus 0 days, allocation_end=null, reimbursable=false}
2 | claim_stream equals "WITHDRAWN" | empty
3 | stay_nights < 0 | INVALID {allocated_nights=stay_nights, allocation_start=accommodation_start plus 0 days, allocation_end=accommodation_start plus stay_nights days, reimbursable=false}
4 | not coverage_confirmed | ASSESSMENT {allocated_nights=eligible_nights, allocation_start=accommodation_start plus 0 days, allocation_end=accommodation_start plus eligible_nights days, reimbursable=false}
5 | claim_stream equals "OWNER_EXPENSE" | OWNER_FUNDED {allocated_nights=stay_nights, allocation_start=accommodation_start plus 0 days, allocation_end=accommodation_start plus stay_nights days, reimbursable=false}
6 | claim_stream equals "CATASTROPHE" and stay_nights >= 5 | EMERGENCY {allocated_nights=3, allocation_start=accommodation_start plus 0 days, allocation_end=accommodation_start plus 3 days, reimbursable=true} -> TEMPORARY {allocated_nights=stay_nights-5, allocation_start=accommodation_start plus 3 days, allocation_end=accommodation_start plus stay_nights-2 days, reimbursable=true} -> RESETTLEMENT {allocated_nights=2, allocation_start=accommodation_start plus stay_nights-2 days, allocation_end=accommodation_start plus stay_nights days, reimbursable=true}
7 | eligible_nights > 28 | STANDARD {allocated_nights=28, allocation_start=accommodation_start plus 0 days, allocation_end=accommodation_start plus 28 days, reimbursable=true} -> EXTENDED {allocated_nights=eligible_nights-28, allocation_start=accommodation_start plus 28 days, allocation_end=accommodation_start plus eligible_nights days, reimbursable=true}
8 | inspection_requested or claim_stream starts with "STRATA_" | ACCOMMODATION {allocated_nights=eligible_nights, allocation_start=accommodation_start plus 0 days, allocation_end=accommodation_start plus eligible_nights days, reimbursable=true} -> PROPERTY_CHECK {allocated_nights=0, allocation_start=accommodation_start plus 0 days, allocation_end=accommodation_start plus 0 days, reimbursable=false}
9 | otherwise | ACCOMMODATION {allocated_nights=eligible_nights, allocation_start=accommodation_start plus 0 days, allocation_end=accommodation_start plus eligible_nights days, reimbursable=true}

stay_nights is the whole elapsed days from accommodation_start to accommodation_end. eligible_nights subtracts waiting_nights, treating a missing waiting period as zero. All dates are UTC midnight; one day means exactly 24 hours. Allocation boundaries use accommodation_start plus the listed day offsets. The allocation_end of UNRESOLVED is absent.

Negative stay lengths are handled only by INVALID. For other completed claims, waiting_nights is between zero and stay_nights. The waiting period applies only to rules expressed using eligible_nights. Emit every listed allocation, including zero-night allocations.

Input 0 Property_claim_1: string claim_reference [required]
date accommodation_start [required]
date accommodation_end [nullable]
long waiting_nights [nullable]
boolean coverage_confirmed [required]
boolean inspection_requested [required]
string claim_stream [required].
Output 0 Accommodation_allocation_1: string originating_claim [required]
string coverage_stage [required]
long allocated_nights [required]
date allocation_start [required]
date allocation_end [nullable]
boolean reimbursable [required].
Source claim_reference values are unique. Preserve each in originating_claim on its allocations.

4 | request_kind equals "RECHECK" and clearance_until differs from null and request_time < clearance_until | empty
5 | current_terms equals proposed_terms and held_deposit equals proposed_deposit and manual_review | REVIEW {terms_code=current_terms, deposit_movement=0, posting_time=request_time, account_ready=false}
6 | current_terms equals proposed_terms and held_deposit equals proposed_deposit | empty
7 | request_kind equals "REGISTER" | CREATE {terms_code=proposed_terms, deposit_movement=0, posting_time=request_time, account_ready=false} -> READY {terms_code=proposed_terms, deposit_movement=proposed_deposit, posting_time=request_time, account_ready=true}
